steps.text: Paging: checkout p99 latency is at 4s in us-east-1. Declaring SEV2.
Looks like the orders database. The connection pool on orders-db is saturated.
I'm taking incident commander. Bumping to SEV1, customers can't complete payment.
eu-west-1 checkout is degraded too.
{recall} {naive} what's the root cause and which regions are affected?
Correction: orders-db is healthy, the pool saturation is a symptom. Root cause is DNS: resolver timeouts since this morning's CoreDNS config change.
eu-west-1 has recovered, that was an unrelated blip. Only us-east-1 is affected.
{recall} {naive} what's the root cause and which regions are affected?
Rolling back the CoreDNS config now.
Rollback is done but latency has not moved, still 4s.
DNS was a red herring, the resolvers were fine after all. The TLS cert on payments-gateway expired at 14:00 and handshakes are failing. That is the cause.
Rotating the cert now, the new one is going out region by region.
ap-southeast-2 is seeing checkout failures now as well.
I have to drop for a customer call. Priya is incident commander from here.
Ack, I have command. Payment retries are getting through now, so downgrading to SEV2.
eu-west-1 is failing again, same cert.
{recall} {naive} who is incident commander, what severity are we at, what's the root cause and which regions are affected?
New cert is deployed in ap-southeast-2 and eu-west-1, both recovered. us-east-1 is still rolling out.
Too early on eu-west-1, two nodes still show handshake errors. eu-west-1 is still affected.
{recall} {naive} which regions are still affected right now?
{recall} {naive} draft a status page update
us-east-1 and eu-west-1 are clean now. Cert is rotated everywhere, monitoring for 15 minutes.
Back from the call. Taking incident commander back from Priya.
{recall} {naive} who is incident commander, what severity are we at, and is any region still affected?
{recall} postmortem
{naive} postmortem
